sections.Profile:
"Alice Cooper's Nightmare Castle," a collaboration between the rock legend and Spooky Pinball, immerses players in a thrilling horror-themed adventure. Released in 2017 and limited to 500 units, this game features over 700 custom call-outs from Alice Cooper himself and integrates ten of his iconic songs, each tied to different game modes such as "Feed My Frankenstein" and "No More Mr. Nice Guy".
